email.foot.tagline: Jonz, fair shares of the housework.
email.deleted.subject: Your Jonz account is deleted
email.deleted.preheader: Your profile, photo and sign-in are gone.
email.deleted.headline: Account deleted
email.deleted.gone: As you asked, your Jonz account is deleted. Your name, photo, email address and sign-in are gone.
email.deleted.again: You can sign up again any time, but this account can’t come back.
email.deleted.notYou: If you didn’t ask for this, reply to this email today.
email.deleted.why: This is the last email this address gets from Jonz.
email.report.subject: {fixed, select, true {Fixed} other {Re}}: {topic} {ref}
email.report.headline: A reply to you
email.report.why: You sent this {about} to Jonz. Reply to this email, or write back in the app.
email.report.whyEmailed: You emailed {address}. Reply to this email to write back.
email.notice.whyStatus: Service notices go to everyone on Jonz.
email.notice.whyNews: You said yes to offers and news from Jonz.
email.message.whyTest: A test of a message from Jonz, sent only to you.
email.message.why: A message from Jonz. Reply to this email to answer it.
email.auth.notYou: If this wasn’t you, ignore this email. Nothing changes without the code.
email.auth.confirmation.subject: Your Jonz code is {code}
email.auth.confirmation.preheader: Type it in to finish making your account.
email.auth.confirmation.headline: Your code
email.auth.confirmation.lead: Type it into Jonz to finish making your account.
email.auth.confirmation.why: You asked for this when you made a Jonz account with this email address.
email.auth.magicLink.subject: Your Jonz code is {code}
email.auth.magicLink.preheader: Type it in to sign in.
email.auth.magicLink.headline: Your code
email.auth.magicLink.lead: Type it into Jonz to sign in.
email.auth.magicLink.why: You asked for this when you signed in to Jonz with this email address.
email.auth.recovery.subject: Reset your Jonz password: {code}
email.auth.recovery.preheader: Type the code in to choose a new password.
email.auth.recovery.headline: Reset your password
email.auth.recovery.lead: Type this code into Jonz, then choose a new password.
email.auth.recovery.notYou: If you didn’t ask to reset it, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
email.auth.recovery.why: You asked to reset the password for this email address on Jonz.
email.auth.emailChange.subject: Confirm your new Jonz email: {code}
email.auth.emailChange.preheader: Type the code in to move your account to this address.
email.auth.emailChange.headline: Confirm this address
email.auth.emailChange.lead: Type this code into Jonz to move your account here.
email.auth.emailChange.notYou: If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email. Your account stays where it is.
email.auth.emailChange.why: Someone asked to move a Jonz account to this email address.
email.auth.reauthentication.subject: Your Jonz code is {code}
email.auth.reauthentication.preheader: Type it in to confirm it’s you.
email.auth.reauthentication.headline: Confirm it’s you
email.auth.reauthentication.lead: Type this code into Jonz to carry on.
email.auth.reauthentication.why: You asked for this while changing your sign-in on Jonz.
email.security.wasYou: If this was you, there’s nothing to do.
email.security.notYouReset: If it wasn’t you, reset your password straight away, then write to {support} so we can help.
email.security.notYouWrite: If it wasn’t you, write to {support} straight away so we can help.
email.security.why: We send this whenever the way you sign in to Jonz changes.
email.security.password.subject: Your Jonz password was changed
email.security.password.headline: Password changed
email.security.password.lead: The password on your Jonz account was just added or changed.
email.security.email.subject: Your Jonz email address was changed
email.security.email.headline: Email changed
email.security.email.lead: Your Jonz account was just moved to a different email address.
email.security.mfaAdded.subject: An authenticator app was added to your Jonz account
email.security.mfaAdded.headline: Authenticator added
email.security.mfaAdded.lead: An authenticator app was just added to your Jonz account.
email.security.mfaRemoved.subject: An authenticator app was removed from your Jonz account
email.security.mfaRemoved.headline: Authenticator removed
email.security.mfaRemoved.lead: An authenticator app was just removed from your Jonz account.
email.security.identityAdded.subject: A new way to sign in was added to your Jonz account
email.security.identityAdded.headline: Sign-in added
email.security.identityAdded.lead: A new way to sign in, like Google or Microsoft, was just added to your Jonz account.
email.security.identityRemoved.subject: A way to sign in was removed from your Jonz account
email.security.identityRemoved.headline: Sign-in removed
email.security.identityRemoved.lead: A way to sign in, like Google or Microsoft, was just removed from your Jonz account.
